map.输入身高与踢腿高度，按踢腿类型与训练水平计算踢腿高度与身高比例，评估柔韧度等级与: Enter height and kick height, and compute the kick height to height ratio by kick type and training level, grading flexibility and kick technique completion.
map.武术/跆拳道训练评估：输入身高、腿长（缺省按身高45%估算）、踢腿离地高度与踢腿: Martial arts / taekwondo training assessment: enter height, leg length (default estimated at 45% of height), kick clearance height and kick type, and compute the height ratio, leg-length ratio and estimated angle to quantify flexibility and technique.
map.技术动作比对：不同类型踢法（前踢/侧踢/旋踢/后踢/高踢）有不同高度系数，工具按: Technique comparison: different kick types (front / side / round / back / high) have different height coefficients, and the tool grades by adjusted height ratio for horizontal comparison.
map.安全提示：用于设定训练目标高度，避免过度追求高度拉伤；角度估算仅供参照，实际受髋: Safety note: use it to set training target height and avoid strains from chasing height; the angle estimate is reference only, and reality also depends on hip flexibility.
map.算例：170cm 身高、前踢离地 165cm: Example: 170 cm height, front kick 165 cm above ground
map.：身高 170cm、腿长缺省=170×45%=76.5cm、踢高 165cm、前:
: height 170 cm, default leg length = 170 × 45% = 76.5 cm, kick height 165 cm, front kick (coefficient 1.0).
Height ratio = 165/170 × 100 = 97.1%; leg-length ratio = 165/76.5 × 100 = 215.7%; estimated angle = asin(165/(76.5+85)) × 180/π = asin(1.0) = 90.0° (the limit is reached and the formula truncates beyond it); adjusted height ratio = 97.1%/1.0 = 97.1% -> grade 'good' (at least 85%). This means a kick above head height is possible.
map.高度比和腿长比怎么理解？: How are the height ratio and leg-length ratio read?
map.高度比=踢高÷身高×100%，反映相对身高能踢多高；腿长比=踢高÷腿长×100%: Height ratio = kick height ÷ height × 100%, showing how high you can kick relative to your height; leg-length ratio = kick height ÷ leg length × 100%, showing how far past leg length you go. Combining the two avoids comparing only absolute height and ignoring body differences.
map.踢腿角度是怎么估算的？: How is the kick angle estimated?
map.按腿长与身高比例近似：角度=asin(踢高÷(腿长+半身高))。该式是简化模型，: Approximated from the leg-length to height ratio: angle = asin(kick height ÷ (leg length + half height)). This is a simplified model; actual kick angle also depends on hip flexibility and torso posture, so it is training reference only and you should not chase height blindly and risk a strain.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.输入身高、可选腿长与踢腿高度，换算高度比、腿长比与估算角度；腿长留空或填 0 时: Enter height, optional leg length and kick height to convert height ratio, leg-length ratio and estimated angle; a blank or 0 leg length is estimated at 45% of height and clearly labeled.
map.身高与踢腿高度分别校验：身高必填且在 120–220cm，踢腿高度可为 0、不得: Height and kick height are validated separately: height is required at 120–220 cm, kick height may be 0 and must not be negative. A blank or 0 leg length is estimated at 45% of height and the used value is shown; a negative value raises an error. Blank or invalid input clears old results.
map.训练数据换算：输入身高、腿长（可留空估算）与踢腿高度，得到高度比、腿长比和估算角: Training data conversion: enter height, leg length (optional, estimated if blank) and kick height to get height ratio, leg-length ratio and estimated angle.
map.动作对比：不同类型踢法有不同高度系数，按调整高度比分组，便于横向查看输入差异。: Action comparison: kick types have different height factors; adjusted height ratios are banded for a side-by-side view of input differences.
map.安全提示：用于设定训练目标高度，避免过度追求高度拉伤；分级只是输入高度的分组，不: Safety: use it to set training height targets and avoid strain from chasing height; the band is only a grouping of the entered height, not a flexibility or technique measurement.
map.：身高170cm、腿长缺省=170×45%=76.5cm、踢高165cm、前踢系: : Height 170 cm, default leg length = 170 × 45% = 76.5 cm, kick height 165 cm, front-kick factor 1.0. Height ratio = 97.1%; leg-length ratio = 215.7%; estimated angle = asin(165/(76.5 + 85)) capped at 90.0°; adjusted ratio 97.1% → band “Good”. A 0 cm kick gives 0.0% and 0.0° without an error.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；角度为简化几何估算，实际受髋关节灵活度与: Runs entirely in the browser and uploads no input; the angle is a simplified geometry estimate, and actual angle depends on hip mobility and torso posture. An estimated leg length is clearly shown; do not treat the band as a flexibility or technique measurement.
map.腿长留空或填 0 会怎样？: What happens if leg length is blank or 0?
map.按身高 45% 估算，并在结果中显示「腿长使用值」与「按身高 45% 估算」提示: It is estimated at 45% of height, and the result shows the used leg length plus an “estimated at 45% of height” note. A negative value raises an error; a positive value is used as entered.
map.角度=asin(踢高÷(腿长+半身高))，超过 1 时截断为 90°。该式是简化: Angle = asin(kick height ÷ (leg length + half height)), capped at 90° when the ratio exceeds 1. This is a simplified model; actual angle also depends on hip mobility and torso posture, so use it as a training reference only.
